title: Meter Tech: Frozen Meter Recovers — Route 41

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is Meter Tech Harris on Route 41. The meter at 123 Oak Street (41-123-OAK) just rebooted and is now showing a flow of 3.2 GPM — it was frozen at 0.000 GPM for 4 hours. I've checked the backflow preventer; it's not leaking. Should I log this as a new anomaly or just note it as a recovery?

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, calm, slightly tired, with a hint of confusion

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it as a non-critical recovery event, not linked to the control-system compromise. Watch for overreaction to meter anomalies.
